memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: So, as the Lord had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, according to their clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin. — Josh 21:3-4 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The land was not the Levites' to take by force; it was given to them by the other tribes "out of their own inheritance." Israel had to share. The families who served in worship — the priests descended from Aaron — were placed right in the middle of the nation, scattered across Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

There is something wise and gracious in this arrangement. God did not tuck His ministers away in one corner. He spread them among the people so that no tribe was ever far from those who taught His word and led in worship. Wherever an Israelite lived, a Levite was nearby.

This is a picture of how God cares for His people's spiritual needs, not just their physical ones. He makes sure the truth is near. Under the New Covenant, we no longer depend on a priestly tribe, because Jesus is our great High Priest, always present, always interceding (Heb 4:14-16). And by His Spirit, God has scattered His people throughout the world to carry His word into every place.

If God arranged even the map of Israel so that His truth would be within reach, you can trust that He has placed you where you are for a reason too.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Has God placed you somewhere to be a witness to those nearby?
2. Do you value having God's word within reach?
3. How does it comfort you that Jesus is your ever-present High Priest?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You keep Your truth near to Your people and that Jesus is my great High Priest. Help me to be a faithful presence wherever You have placed me. Amen.
